Several days (the Between the Lines Quest takes 4–6 hours; after that it is farming two bosses with a 20 h cooldown and 3.5% and 2% drop rates)

The {wiki:Illuminator Outfits|Illuminator Outfits} are tied to the {wiki:Book World|Book World}, the world inside a book in Edron castle. The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}. At the end of that quest, {npc:Wyrdin} tells you that two accessories have been stolen: the {item:Scallop Shell}, which drops from the {creature:Tropical Desolator} (painting in Liberty Bay), gives the 1st addon, and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn}, which drops from the {creature:Wrathful Archivist} (painting in Yalahar), gives the 2nd. With both addons you earn the achievement **Illuminator**.
Phillip, Carlin school (start of the Between the Lines Quest)
**Premium** account (the outfit and addons are Premium only).
Level **200** (minimum level for the quest and for the {spell:Summon Familiar} spell); **recommended level 300+**.
Base outfit: complete the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest} (it requires the {spell:Summon Familiar} spell and an item that depends on your vocation; see section 1).
The painting bosses ({creature:Tropical Desolator}, {creature:Blight Mariner} and {creature:Wrathful Archivist}) **only become accessible after you finish the Between the Lines Quest**.
The {spell:Levitate} spell, to get up to the roof where the Wrathful Archivist's painting is, in Yalahar.

Boat to Yalahar: {npc:Jack Fate} (Liberty Bay, 275 gp) and {npc:Captain Bluebear} (Thais, 200 gp) take you with no conditions listed on the wiki; {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay, 400 gp) only after you start the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}.
gives the 1st addon; drops from Tropical Desolator (3.5%) or can be bought on the Market
gives the 2nd addon; drops from Wrathful Archivist (2.0%) or can be bought on the Market

Sorcerers, in the Between the Lines Quest (Phoenix Feather Quill in Kazordoon)

Vocation items for the Between the Lines Quest: Knights — {item:Sword} and {item:Inkwell}; Druids — {item:Sling Herb} and {item:Star Herb}; Monks — {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment} and an {item:Adventurer's Stone} (to get to Blue Valley); Paladins and Sorcerers get theirs during the quest.
optional: the wiki does not describe the exit from the painting rooms; takes you to your home town's temple
Health and mana potions for the bosses; protection against **earth** helps against Tropical Desolator, and against **death** and **energy** against Wrathful Archivist.
{wiki:Illuminator Outfits|Illuminator} base outfit (male and female), when you finish the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}
Along the way: achievement **Power of Words**, both parts of the {item:Painting of Thais} and your familiar's figurine (Between the Lines Quest rewards)
Base: final report to {npc:Wyrdin} in the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}. Addons: by using the {item:Scallop Shell} (1st) and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} (2nd).
Requires Premium. Both addon items can be bought on the Market.
Painting bosses: Tropical Desolator (Liberty Bay), Blight Mariner (Venore) and Wrathful Archivist (Yalahar)
After finishing the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}, when {npc:Wyrdin} tells you about the stolen accessories.
The Tropical Desolator and the Blight Mariner have a 20 h cooldown.
If you have already done the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}, skip straight to section 2: the base outfit is already yours and the painting bosses are already unlocked.

The {item:Scallop Shell} and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} are **tradeable on the Market** (no NPC buys or sells them). If the drops (3.5% and 2.0%) do not come your way, you can buy them from other players.

Do both bosses in the same trip: Edron → Liberty Bay ({creature:Tropical Desolator}) → Yalahar ({creature:Wrathful Archivist}), taking the boat from Liberty Bay to Yalahar with {npc:Jack Fate} or {npc:Captain Max}.
The first time you kill Tropical Desolator, it drops a {item:Proficiency Catalyst}.
Bring {item:Cheese}, {item:Baguette} and {item:Meat} for Wrathful Archivist: they save time in one of the mechanics (if you have none, there is a machine in the room that gives you the food).

The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}. Here is a summary of every stage, with the coordinates; that quest's guide covers each step in detail (travel, each vocation task and the exits from each area). The quest starts in Carlin, continues in Edron and ends in the {wiki:Book World|Book World}, a world inside a book in the Edron castle library.
Go to Carlin and talk to Phillip

Take a boat to **Carlin** (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}, 110 gp). You arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}. Go to the Carlin school and talk to {npc:Phillip}: {key:hi} and {key:book}. He tells you a monster came out of his book; agree to deal with it and he tells you the monster left a **trail of ink**.
Follow the ink and kill Inkwing

Follow the ink trail to the outskirts of Carlin, to the **east** ({coord:32510,31744,7}), and **go down**. Follow the corridors to the end and step on the **ink puddle** on the floor: you face {creature:Inkwing} (12,000 health, summons {creature:Vicious Ink Splash|Vicious Ink Splashes}; 2 h cooldown).
End of the ink trail (way down)
Leave the lair and report to Phillip

Go back through the same corridors to where you went down ({coord:32510,31744,7}) and walk back to Carlin, to the **west**. Say {key:hi} and {key:book} to {npc:Phillip}: he sends you to talk to {npc:Wyrdin}, in **Edron**.
Go to Edron and talk to Wyrdin

At the Carlin port, say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Greyhound}. In Edron, go to the Ivory Towers of the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}, in the **eastern** part of the city. {npc:Wyrdin} is in the middle tower, **1 floor above** the ground. Say {key:hi} and {key:book}: he asks you for three book pages that are acting as portals.
Collect the three Illuminated Book Pages

Go down **three floors** and through the quest door to the **east**. In the hunting area ({creature:Cinder Wyrmling|Cinder Wyrmlings} and {creature:Shell Drake|Shell Drakes}) use the three objects in the table to collect the pages. Then go back up the same stairs to {npc:Wyrdin}.

Say {key:hi} and {key:book} to {npc:Wyrdin}. The counter-spell worked for the academy's two pages: return them to their books, one **1 floor above** in the central tower and the other in the **southernmost** tower. Then go back to Wyrdin and say {key:book}.
Use page C on the castle book
Go to **Edron castle** and use the {item:Illuminated Book Page (C)} on the book in the library, **west** of {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}. Some claws pull your familiar into the pages.
From here on **you can no longer use {spell:Summon Familiar}** until you finish the quest.

Say {key:hi} and {key:book} to {npc:Wyrdin}. To save your familiar you have to enter the book, but first each vocation prepares something different (table). The trips to and from Thais, Kazordoon and Blue Valley are in the next step. {npc:Luna} sells the {item:Star Herb} (Edron, 21 gp); the {item:Sling Herb} cannot be bought: you pick it from daily respawns, for example at Donald McRonald's farm in Thais ({coord:32405,32241,7}).
Buy a {item:Sword} from {npc:Willard} and an {item:Inkwell} from {npc:Thomas} (both in Edron) and use one on the other
Talk to {npc:Quentin} in the Thais temple: {key:Getema}
Go up 4 floors above Wyrdin to the laboratory of {npc:Sinclair} ({coord:33268,31835,2}) and use a {item:Sling Herb} and a {item:Star Herb} on the {item:Suspicious Cauldron|Suspicious Cauldrons}
{item:Jar of Blue Colour} and {item:Jar of Red Colour}
In Kazordoon, near {npc:Pydar}, use a {item:Rope} at {coord:32631,31884,11}, click the yellow/orange fire field to the east and climb back up with the rope
Wearing the {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment}, go to {wiki:Blue Valley}, climb to the top floor of the main building and stand between the two statues ({coord:33604,31454,4})
Trips for your vocation (there and back)
Knights and Druids do everything in Edron. Paladins, Sorcerers and Monks have to travel: follow your vocation's row.
How to get back to Edron

At the Edron port, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (160 gp). You arrive at the Thais port ({npc:Captain Bluebear}, {coord:32310,32210,6}); {npc:Quentin} is in the temple ({coord:32369,32239,7})
At the Thais port, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (160 gp)

{npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). In Cormaya, go down 8 floors to the Steamship, at the end of Cormaya Street, and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} to {npc:Gurbasch} ({coord:33313,31989,15}) (160 gp). You arrive far below Kazordoon, next to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}); go up to the floor of {npc:Pydar} ({coord:32655,31893,11})

Climb up with the {item:Rope} and go down to {npc:Brodrosch}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (160 gp). At the northern port of Cormaya, {npc:Pemaret} ({coord:33287,31956,6}): {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp)

Use an {item:Adventurer's Stone} in a city temple (if you do not have one, ask the temple NPC for it: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}) to go to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild|Adventurers' Guild}. There, use the {wiki:Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere|Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere}: you arrive in Blue Valley ({coord:33603,31469,7})

Use the {wiki:Guarded Crystal Sphere|Guarded Crystal Sphere} in Blue Valley to go back to the Adventurers' Guild, leave through the guild portal to the temple you came from and take a boat to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes})
Get the Magic Bookmark and enter the Book World

Go back to {npc:Wyrdin} and say {key:book}: you get a {item:Magic Bookmark}. With it in your inventory, use the castle library book to enter the {wiki:Book World|Book World}. Talk to {npc:Quill (NPC)|Quill} ({key:hi}, {key:mission}): your familiar has been kidnapped by the crusaders of {creature:Sir Leonard}.
If you lose the Magic Bookmark during the quest, ask Wyrdin for another one with {key:lost bookmark}.

Use the scroll on the floor to get a {item:Dip Pen}, fill it at an ink puddle or fountain ({item:Dip Pen with Ink}) and write on a blank space to get a {item:Painted Torch}. Use the torch on the **fire flowers** on the floor to open holes between chapters. Complete Quill's mission in your vocation's chapter (table).
Quill, Dip Pen and Painted Torch; burn the fire flower and go down

**Druid**: {item:Painted Bandages} ({coord:32542,32560,9}), 3 {item:Painted Healing Herbs} ({coord:32532,32553,9}, {coord:32517,32576,9}, {coord:32540,32582,9}), {item:Saturated Painted Bandages} on the white deer ({coord:32548,32565,9}) → {item:Deer Fur Brush}. **Paladin**: {item:Painted Bow} ({coord:32539,32514,9}), {item:Painted Arrow} ({coord:32536,32539,9}) and 3 accurate shots at the targets, standing on the wax seals. Exit: fire flower {coord:32544,32609,9}

Write a {item:Boat Ticket} near the boat ({coord:32593,32568,10}) and take the boat to the east. To reach the eastern area use the north-west corridor (or, with Quill's mission done, the shortcut through the treasure room). **Knight**: kill 30 Lion Hydras. **Monk**: talk to {npc:Death (NPC)|Death} ({coord:32572,32574,11}) about {key:loss} and {key:acceptance}

**Sorcerer**: light the candles with the Painted Torch at {coord:32586,32517,11}, {coord:32645,32520,11} and {coord:32616,32557,11} (each time you take damage equal to 44.15% of your current health). Then, the boss teleport at {coord:32631,32560,11}
Defeat Sir Leonard and save your familiar

Enter the teleport at {coord:32631,32560,11} and kill {creature:Sir Leonard} (22,000 health, summons up to 5 {creature:Crusader Guardian|Crusader Guardians}; no special mechanics; 2 h cooldown). Leave the room to the **south**, use your vocation item on the sealed door, talk to your familiar and say {key:saving}. Take the figurine from the chest.
Item to use on the sealed door
{item:Painted Bow} (with 3 {item:Painted Arrow|Painted Arrows} in your backpack)
Take **all the quest items** from the previous stages with you. Paladins must have {item:The Sacred Writings of Getema}, otherwise they are not taken to the familiar's room after the fight.

Leave the familiar's room through the **door** and enter the **teleport** on the floor. Then go back through all the chapters (IV, III, II and I) and leave the Book World into the **Edron** castle library.

Go back to the Ivory Towers and say {key:hi} and {key:book} to {npc:Wyrdin} one last time. You get the **Illuminator** base outfit, both parts of the {item:Painting of Thais} and the achievement **Power of Words**.

{npc:Wyrdin} also tells you that two accessories were stolen: a {item:Scallop Shell} and a {item:Sand-Filled Horn}. The possible thieves are **inside paintings** in Liberty Bay, Venore and Yalahar. You can only face them from now on, with the Between the Lines Quest finished.

{creature:Tropical Desolator} is an Iks boss (Bosstiary: Archfoe) hidden in a painting in Liberty Bay. It has **20,500** health, gives **23,000** experience, sees invisible, cannot be paralysed and walks over energy, fire and poison fields. **20-hour** cooldown and a fight of **10 minutes** at most.
In **Edron**, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (170 gp). You disembark at the **Liberty Bay** port.
The Tropical Desolator painting is **1 floor above** the ground, in the port area, in the **south** of Liberty Bay, near the guard {npc:Marcus}. Go up to that floor and head to the coordinate.
Click (use) the **painting** to enter the room of {creature:Tropical Desolator}.
It only works after you finish the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest} and if you are not on cooldown (20 h after your last win).

The boss attacks in **melee**, never flees and summons 1–2 creatures: {creature:Bound Ape}, {creature:Bound Cave Spider} or {creature:Bound Iks Aucar}. It takes more damage from **fire** (110%) and **ice** (105%) and slightly less from **earth** (95%); holy and energy at 100%.
Attack with fire or ice and bring earth protection because of the Blastberry.
Every **10 seconds** a random fruit appears, counts down from **5** and then explodes in an area. Move away from the fruit and **keep the boss away from it**.
Large explosion that **heals the boss up to 7,000** if it is in range
Never leave the boss on top of or next to a Blamana when it explodes: you lose a good part of the damage you dealt.
Kill Tropical Desolator and check the loot
Kill the boss and open the corpse. The {item:Scallop Shell} drops in **3.5%** of kills (342 samples on the wiki). If you do not get it, try again after 20 hours or buy it on the Market.
Tropical Desolator loot (may include the Scallop Shell)
Leave the room and Liberty Bay

The wiki does not describe how to leave the painting room: look for the exit in the room itself. If you cannot find it, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your home town's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block / Protection Zone Block). To go on to the 2nd addon, take a boat to Yalahar at the Liberty Bay port: {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 275 gp) or {npc:Captain Max}, on one of the boats to the **east** of the pier ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 400 gp, only after you start the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}). To go back to Edron, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you for 170 gp ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
Use the {item:Scallop Shell}. The message *"Your illuminator robes look more impressive now."* appears and you get the Illuminator's **1st addon**.

{creature:Wrathful Archivist} is a Voodoo Cultist boss (Bosstiary: Archfoe) in a painting on the roof of a house in Yalahar's Inner City. It has **15,000** health, gives **24,000** experience, sees invisible and deals **death**, **energy** and **mana drain** damage (estimated max damage 1,325+). It starts out **immortal**: you can only hurt it after completing a random mechanic.

From **Liberty Bay**: {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 275 gp) or {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 400 gp, only after you start the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}). From **Thais**: {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 200 gp); from Edron you get to Thais with {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({key:thais}, 160 gp). You arrive at the Yalahar port, **south** of the Inner City.
From the port, walk **north** to the **Inner City**. {npc:Soilance}, the meat seller, has his house **north of the bank**. The painting is on the **roof** of that house.
Get onto the roof with Levitate
Leave the house and go round to the **right-hand (east) side, outside**. There, use {spell:Levitate} up to get onto the roof, where the painting is.
Click (use) the **painting** to enter the room of {creature:Wrathful Archivist}.
It only works after you finish the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest}.
When you enter, the boss is **immortal**. After about **15 seconds**, **blue books** appear in the room. Click one of them: a **random mechanic** starts (table in the next step).
Solve the mechanic you got. As soon as you complete it, the boss becomes vulnerable.
Deactivate the runes by clicking them in this order: **east**, **west** and **north**.

Feed all the animals: throw each one's favourite food on the floor and make them walk over it — {item:Cheese} for the rats, bread ({item:Baguette}) for the rabbits and {item:Meat} for the rotworms. If you have no food, go to the far **west** end of the room and use the machine there.

You have about **15 seconds** to hit {creature:Wrathful Archivist}. If it does not die in that time, blue books appear again: click another one, complete the new random mechanic and hit it again. Repeat until it dies.
Save your strongest attacks (and attack potions) for the 15-second windows. Bring protection against **death** and **energy**.
Open the corpse. The {item:Sand-Filled Horn} drops in **2.0%** of kills (344 samples on the wiki). If you do not get it, come back later or buy it on the Market.
Wrathful Archivist loot (may include the Sand-Filled Horn)

The wiki does not describe how to leave the painting room: look for the exit in the room itself. If you end up back on the roof, use {spell:Levitate} down to get back to the street. If you cannot find an exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your home town's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block / Protection Zone Block). To leave Yalahar, go to the port (**south** of the Inner City) and talk to {npc:Captain Cookie}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp), and {key:yes}. If you have already done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}, {npc:Karith} (on the boat 1 floor above, at the same port) is cheaper: Thais 200, Venore 185, Carlin 185, Ab'Dendriel 160, Liberty Bay 275, Darashia 210, Ankrahmun 230 and Port Hope 260 gp. From Thais you get back to Edron with {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({key:edron}, 160 gp).

Use the {item:Sand-Filled Horn}: you get the Illuminator's **2nd addon**. When you have **both addons** you earn the achievement **Illuminator** (3 points): *"Joran and Yvette have brought the colours back to the world, and you have freed it from the monsters of this story. The world of books is now yours."*
The Illuminator Outfits, the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest} and the three painting bosses arrived in version 15.10.46b862 (Summer Update 2025, 21 July 2025).

{creature:Blight Mariner} (painting in Venore, {coord:33000,32034,4}, 3 floors above the ground; from Edron you get there with {npc:Captain Seahorse}, {key:venore}) is one of the three "suspects" in the theft, but it **drops neither** the Scallop Shell nor the Sand-Filled Horn. It is only worth doing for the loot and the Bosstiary; the strategy is in the {wiki:Between the Lines Quest|Between the Lines Quest} guide.
Tropical Desolator and Blight Mariner have a 20-hour cooldown and a maximum fight time of 10 minutes. The wiki does not give Wrathful Archivist's cooldown.

The {item:Scallop Shell} (*"It has been used as a colour palette."*) and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} (*"The fine, white sand is trickling out."*) weigh 1.20 oz each, are tradeable and no NPC buys or sells them.
